main.description: List the kubeconfigs issued for the named cluster of the calling account: one ClusterClientCertificate record per kubeconfig, revoked ones included. The account is the verified token's iss. No key or certificate is returned.

name.description: The cluster label of the calling account.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: This account has no cluster of that name.

serial.description: The client certificate serial, lowercase hex. revokeKubeconfig takes it.

noExpiry.description: Issued with noExpiry (or ttlSeconds 0): it ends only by revocation.
